Verify Stachel supporting-line geometry completeness, reversals, stars and ordinary distances.
Read primary sources independently for exact scope and normalization.
Challenge implicit novelty, priority, independence or global literature conclusions.
Inspect actual portable checks and README guidance.
Run reproducible independent meaningful checks using read-only pinned mpmath 1.3.0 runtime.

Render current PDF and inspect all pages.
Report every substantive gap with exact evidence and actionable repair.
Produce comprehensive report, machine findings and review manifest.

success_criterion: Clean only if the exact package supports a correct, honestly delimited and reproducibly verified result with no material unresolved issue. Otherwise needs repair.
